title: Inline Functions and Performance
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of inline functions and performance using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Inline Functions and Performance** as part of **Advanced Kotlin Language Features**. Kotlin functions can expose parameters and return types, and function values/lambdas allow behavior to be passed to or returned from other functions. Use the subtopics—Inline Lambdas, Non-Local Returns, Inline Function API Restrictions—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.
